sn9.6:1.2: Penelope (_jālinī_) means “weaver”, and is used as a term for the craving that binds beings in transmigration (eg. [an4.199]()). Compare _tantrāyī_ at Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 14.2.2.22.
sn9.6:3.4: Per Bodhi”s *Connected Discourses*, adopt reading _devakaññābhisattikā_ found in a Sinhala-script manuscript cited in the PTS edition.
